items.label: 100% Metal Garden Trellis
items.value: Our tower obelisk garden trellis is made of 13mm Extra thick rust-proof metal tube with exquisite Black finish,more sturdy and durable,not easy to crack. 6.6FT tall obelisk trellis support frame and four ground stakes at the base for secure fixation.Round Trellis provide excellent support for your plants and vines to climb.

items: Flower Trellises：Our Metal Obelisk Garden Trellis set include 2pack 6.6Ft 100% Metal black Round Trellis，1 pack Garden Twist Tie，10 pcs Butterfly Garden Stakes.

items.label: Unique Design
items.value: This vertical tower obelisk with a beautiful design. The metal ring design of the top is ideal for hanging hummingbird feeder or garden ornaments.Garden trellis for climbing plants isn't just for outdoor use, suitable for climbing plants, climbing roses, and tomatoes, but it can also be used to support indoor plant stands and potted plants. Decor Flowers Stands with wreaths for festive decorations, or add string lights to create a dreamy nighttime effect.

items.label: Assemble Freely
items.value: Garden fence tube is pre-cut and pre-drilled. The garden stand should be assembled from bottom to top. To facilitate subsequent installation, please tighten the screws only after complete assembly. To enhance stability, insert the garden trellis 6-8 inches into the soil to ensure it doesn't wobble during use.

items.label: Widely Used
items.value: Our metal obelisk trellis Can help the growth of flowering vines like climbing roses, mandevila, clematis, honey suckle , ivy, jasmine and morning glories, tomatoes, cucumbers, eggplants, blackberries, beans, grapevines, long stems, fruit vines, houseplants, etc.
